faq: Do you copy my old theme exactly?

We recreate the look and layout, using the new platform's own tools. Paid themes and custom code from the old store cannot be copied across, so we rebuild the features with what the new platform offers.
Can I change the design while we move?
Yes. Many owners use the move to tidy up. Tell us what to keep and what to change, and we mark each choice in the preview so you can approve it before launch.
Who pays for the new theme?
If a paid theme is the best fit, you buy it in your own account and we install it. Free themes work well for many stores. We recommend the cheaper option first and explain the difference.
Is the design checked on mobile?
Yes. Most orders come from phones, so we test the home, product, cart and checkout pages on small screens and fix layout problems before you see the preview.

desc:
Store design recreation on a new platform means rebuilding the look of your old store, or giving it a fresh start, inside a new theme. Ecom Swift LLC rebuilds your logo, colors, fonts and page layouts so shoppers still recognize your brand after the move.

## What is store design recreation?

Store design recreation is the work of reproducing a store's appearance on a different platform. Themes and templates do not move between platforms, so the design has to be rebuilt by hand. That covers the header, menu, home page, collection pages, product pages, cart and footer.

You can choose a close match to the old design, or use the move as a chance to simplify. Both routes start with the same step: studying what you have now.

## Why the design should survive the move

Your regular customers know your store by sight. If the colors, fonts and layout change overnight with no warning, some of them wonder whether they landed on the right site. A familiar look tells them the business is the same, even though the platform underneath is new.

A rushed rebuild causes the opposite problem. A theme dropped in with default settings looks like thousands of other stores and hides what makes your brand different. Careful recreation keeps your identity while taking advantage of what the new platform does well.

## How layout affects sales

Design is not decoration. The placement of the price, the size of the add-to-cart button and the order of sections on a product page all change how easily a shopper decides. A layout that worked for your old store may need small changes on a new theme, because spacing and components are different.

Mobile is the first test. Most visitors browse on phones, so menus, filters and image galleries must be easy to use with one hand. We check each page on small and large screens before you see the preview.

## What a good recreation includes

- A theme chosen for your product type, such as a theme built for large catalogs or one for a handful of hero products.
- Your logo, colors and fonts applied the same way on every page.
- A header and footer with working menus, search and links to your policies.
- A home page with sections arranged to match your old store or an improved order.
- Collection page layouts with sorting and filters that suit your catalog.
- Product page layouts with image galleries, variant selectors and clear price display.
- Styled cart and search pages, so the whole shopping path looks like one brand.
- Extra pages such as About, Contact and size guides rebuilt.
- Image sizes and loading checked so pages stay quick.

## What we do

First we review your old store page by page and collect your brand files. Then we choose or confirm a theme, set up the global styles and build the main templates. We add the sections you want on the home page and recreate the pages you name.

You receive a private preview link before anything goes live. You can click through it on your own phone, tell us what to adjust and approve the final result. The Basic, Standard and Premium packages differ in how closely the old design is matched, how many custom sections and extra pages are built, and whether menus, product page layouts and a speed pass are included.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Send your logo in its original file format, not a screenshot.
- Choose a theme that suits your catalog size.
- Keep the number of fonts to two.
- Approve the preview on a real phone.
- Decide early which old pages you still need.

**Avoid:**
- Copying every old detail that never worked well.
- Filling the home page with sliders and pop-ups.
- Picking a theme only because of its demo photos.
- Changing the design again after launch week begins.
- Leaving unused old sections hidden in the theme.

## Who this is for

A brand moving platforms that wants to keep its look. An owner who finds the old design dated and wants a cleaner start along with the move. A small team with no designer, who needs a tidy storefront built to a clear brief.

## What we need from you

Share the address of your current store, your logo files, brand colors and fonts if you have them, and any pages you want kept. Tell us which parts you love and which you want changed.

The new theme license is bought in your own account if it is a paid one. We work in your store as a staff or collaborator user, and we never ask for passwords.
